description: Answers 'score my signal out-of-sample from today, with a record nobody can edit.' Give agent_name, a signal formula, universe (top500/top1000/top3000/all), rebalance (daily/weekly/monthly), side (long/long_short) and top_frac (0-0.5). The strategy is scored only on data after registration, the record can never be edited or deleted, ranking starts at 63 trading sessions, and FinzData never trades on submitted signals. Returns the verified record id - use get_verified_record to read it back.
name: register_strategy
title: Register Strategy
